claim_ceiling: Synthetic sampling design contract only. No site-specific sampling plan, permit-approved design, statistical power, sensor deployment, baseline or environmental result is established.

standards_context.ocean_variables: GOOS Essential Ocean Variables; specification version must be pinned per campaign
standards_context.biodiversity: OBIS Manual v2.0 / Darwin Core; confirm data provider, node and rights requirements

decision_questions.question: What are the time-resolved thermal plume exposure, duration and spatial extent relative to independent reference conditions?
Does the system add a measurable pollutant mass load above intake/background after accounting for transport time and measurement uncertainty?
Are benthic habitat, taxa and relevant biodiversity indicators changed relative to seasonal reference/control observations?
Does underwater sound vary by equipment, duty cycle, vessel activity and construction/maintenance state?

spatial_design.location_rule: Coordinates, depth, range, datum and station spacing must be set after site-specific hydrography, plume modelling, ecological baseline and regulatory review. No generic universal plume radius or distance is assumed.
spatial_design.control_rule: Reference/control must be outside the modeled/observed influence of the intervention under relevant conditions, matched for habitat and hydrographic context, and independently justified. If independence cannot be established, the comparison remains confounded/UNKNOWN.
spatial_design.impact_area_rule: Use a predeclared impact area and retain fixed stations where feasible; adaptive stations may supplement but must not replace the pre-registered spatial design without a documented amendment.

temporal_strata.evidence_basis: site-specific seasonal metocean and ecological calendar
temporal_strata.coverage: each material season represented before making annual or seasonal claims

temporal_strata.evidence_basis: measured current, mixing, tide and sea-state distributions
temporal_strata.coverage: sampling includes conditions controlling plume transport and intake recirculation

temporal_strata.evidence_basis: synchronized accepted IT service and heat-exchanger operating state
temporal_strata.coverage: all material thermal operating states sampled

temporal_strata.evidence_basis: operator event log and metered hydraulic state
temporal_strata.coverage: all discharge-relevant activities explicitly included or declared not applicable with evidence

temporal_strata.evidence_basis: event-triggered sampling under approved response plan
temporal_strata.coverage: incident samples collected only where safe and authorized; otherwise event and missingness are explicitly recorded
claims do not cross unobserved lifecycle stages

sampling_channels.sampling_rule: Sampling cadence is selected from instrument response, validated hydraulic residence-time distribution and fastest relevant thermal transient; preserve raw time series and clock quality. Five-times-per-rise-time is a proposed engineering screening heuristic, not a standard requirement.
Continuous or repeated profiling sufficient to resolve stratification, mixing and seasonal/event variability; pin instrument deployment and calibration.

Use a site-specific representative sampling plan following ISO 5667-10:2026 where applicable; record method, preservation, collection window, chain of custody, lab batch, blank/duplicate/spike results and censoring method.

Independent ecologist pre-registers methods, spatial support, taxonomic level, seasonal timing, effort and reference/control design; minimize disturbance and follow permit and sensitive-species rules.
Calibrated hydrophone survey across duty cycles, source/receptor positions, ranges and depth; distinguish ambient, vessel and infrastructure sources.
Event register time-linked to environmental channels, include before/during/after sampling where safe and required; disposal and material custody are recorded.

event_triggers.when: IT load, pump command or measured heat-transfer rate changes beyond the pre-registered threshold
event_triggers.action: increase thermal/hydraulic sampling density through the response and residence-time window

event_triggers.when: outfall concentration, temperature, turbidity or other validated monitor crosses a pre-approved alert threshold
event_triggers.action: preserve raw streams, collect confirmatory samples under approved method, alert responsible operator and apply approved mitigation

event_triggers.when: screen, filter, exchanger or pipe cleaning begins
event_triggers.action: capture before/during/after flow, chemistry and waste handling; record all cleaning agents and discharge routing

event_triggers.when: current, wave or stratification enters a pre-registered transport regime
event_triggers.action: increase plume/chemistry observations or mark regime uncovered if resources/safety prevent it

event_triggers.when: independent ecological observation or intake monitoring indicates an ecological trigger
event_triggers.action: stop/modify affected operation under approved response plan; do not wait for a composite score

statistical_design.primary_contrast_required: pre-register at least one primary contrast per decision question before observing outcomes
statistical_design.minimum_detectable_effect: set from ecological relevance, permit requirements or engineering decision consequence before collecting confirmatory data; not inferred after observing results
statistical_design.power_analysis: pilot variance, temporal autocorrelation, spatial clustering, expected censoring, detection limits, unequal sampling and multiple comparisons must be included; the sample count is derived from the registered model, not hard-coded here
statistical_design.independent_unit_rule: Do not treat repeated sensor readings from one station, one deployment or one biological sample as independent field replicates; model nested temporal/spatial structure and avoid pseudoreplication.
statistical_design.multiplicity_rule: Declare a primary endpoint and handle secondary endpoints/multiple analytes with a pre-registered multiplicity strategy.

adaptive_sampling_policy.optimization_goal: maximize expected reduction in decision regret per sampling cost while preserving pre-registered coverage, rights, ecological and safety constraints
adaptive_sampling_policy.rule: Adaptive sampling may add observations or shift effort within a predeclared design envelope; it may not quietly remove inconvenient stations, unobserved regimes or primary endpoints. Every adaptation carries a reason, version, affected contrast and reviewer receipt.

quality_and_rights.rule: Missing, censored, stale, uncalibrated, rights-ineligible or contradictory evidence remains unknown/qualified with an explicit status; it is never converted to zero.

stop_rules.condition: pre-construction or seasonal reference baseline is missing
independent control is not demonstrably outside the impact area or not comparable
stop_rules.disposition: mark contrast confounded and block causal claim

stop_rules.condition: power analysis cannot resolve the pre-registered minimum detectable effect
stop_rules.disposition: redesign study or label result underpowered; no no-effect claim

stop_rules.condition: sample method, preservation, rights or custody fails
material event/season/regime has no valid observation
stop_rules.disposition: retain coverage gap and restrict claim to observed regimes

stop_rules.condition: protected/exclusion habitat, permit breach or ecological trigger occurs
stop_rules.disposition: block/stop affected activity under approved response plan

proposed_benchmarks.complete_provenance: 100% of accepted observations carry required metadata and a raw-data digest
proposed_benchmarks.control_integrity: 100% of primary contrasts have independently justified reference/control stations
proposed_benchmarks.statistical_design: 80% or greater power at alpha 0.05 for the pre-registered primary effect, where a quantitative contrast is appropriate
proposed_benchmarks.event_coverage: 100% of material planned operating/maintenance events are either sampled or explicitly recorded as uncovered
proposed_benchmarks.seasonal_coverage: all seasons/material strata needed for the intended claim are covered; no annual claim from a single-season baseline
proposed_benchmarks.missingness: zero silent interpolation or zero-fill; publish observed duration, gap durations and reason codes
proposed_benchmarks.adaptation_auditability: 100% of adaptive changes have immutable design-version and reviewer receipts

comparison_policy: Compare alternative placements or cooling architectures only with matched primary contrasts, season/hydrodynamic regimes, service/load states, metrology and measurement uncertainty. No site or architecture wins by having fewer samples or missing regimes.

owner_native_research.scope: bias-aware non-contact survey design; this campaign consumes its survey-bias and non-contact evidence guidance
temporal replication and imperfect-detection benchmark; this campaign adopts explicit detection-probability and repeated-visit constraints
sensor selection by parameter identifiability and decision value; this campaign uses a constrained expected-information/decision-regret allocation objective

imperfect_detection_model.rule: Latent ecological state and observation/detection process are separate model layers. A non-detection is not absence unless the sampling method, detection probability, effort, conditions and uncertainty support that inference.
imperfect_detection_model.acceptance: For any primary ecological contrast based on detection, estimate or justify detection probability using the registered design. Where detectability is unknown or insufficient, report absence as UNKNOWN and do not infer no effect.
imperfect_detection_model.integration: Use the current sequential-design and observation-allocation work for repeated visits, imperfect detection and non-contact survey bias; do not reimplement a competing ecological estimator in this campaign contract.
